summary: Each edition was reviewed independently against all clauses of the selected Greek working source. Both preserve the mountain imagery, differentiated descriptions, supplied negation, difficult rather than impossible entry, urgent repentance, conditional life promise, and death consequence. The simplified edition retains these substantive distinctions despite shorter sentences. Both use policy-compliant servant and repentance terminology. The notes distinguish editorial supplies and the conjectural women reading from reported alternatives; their principal witness disclosures agree with the supplied project reports and do not claim complete manuscript verification. Acceptance concerns fidelity to this selected working source and the supplied disclosures, not authentication of unseen manuscripts, exhaustive collation, or a uniquely established interpretation.
